test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘POWER’ is written as ‘RRAJX’ and ‘HELLO’ is written as ‘JHPQU’. How will ‘NEVER’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positions of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**POWER : RRAJX**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a80df4b677b2222019ad34717ce3118b721732c13f03e996cb4ab5e7dfc63ed7.png] 

**HELLO : JHPQU**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffc088c43055534886bf2c92fb46ac7fa81cd5f4c8c8c1bde25249276dbb33d6.png] 

**Similarly, for NEVER**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54824e0a6a19e905d70dffa890f135a6cb04994e8ec67ea5912dbd7ed8c3d22c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"PHZJX". **
